raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. a. evening before stated religious festival or holiday, malam: on New Year’s ~, pd malam Tahun Baru; b. day before stated religious festival or holiday, hari sebelum: Christmas ~, hari sebelum Krismas; 2. time just before an important event, menjelang: he became ill on the ~ of the competition, dia jatuh sakit menjelang pertandingan itu; 3. ( archaic or poet. ) evening, malam. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
